Theorem
[Hamilton–Ivey curvature pinching] Source: cao-zhu 1. Theorem 2.4.1\group Cao–Zhu Hamilton-Ivey Curvature Pinching Estimate Suppose we have a solution to the Ricci flow on a three-manifold which is complete with bounded curvature for each $t\geq 0$. Assume at $t=0$ the eigenvalues $\lambda \geq \mu \geq u $ of the curvature operator at each point are bounded below by $ u \geq -1$. The scalar curvature $R=\lambda +\mu + u $ is their sum. Then at all points and all times $t\geq 0$ we have the pinching estimate \[ R\geq (- u )[\log (- u )-3], \] whenever $ u <0$.

Proof

↗ thm:cz-advanced-maximum-principle-for-time-dependent-tensors \sketch The closed convex region $R\ge -3$ and $ u +f^{-1}(R)\ge 0$ is preserved by the curvature-operator ODE, hence by the advanced maximum principle.

□
